author: Juno.eth
text:
We spend hundreds on fancy blue-light glasses and sleep supplements, yet doomscroll until 2 AM anyway.

The friction was never the gear. It was the lack of immediate feedback.


@sleepagotchi
 fixes the psychology by tying your wake-up time directly to morning asset drops and room enhancements. 

Sticking to my sleep schedule suddenly feels like leveling up an RPG character.

Make the right choice fun, and the habit takes care of itself.
